completion_lanes.name: Version 1.0 Release Gate
completion_lanes.why_open: Backend MVP is complete, but official Version 1.0 requires the new UI to be live; deploy/tag/distribution remains separate live release work.
completion_lanes.done_when: New UI is live, /api/version-one/readiness is Go, rollback target is named, and release/deploy/tag/distribution decision is explicitly approved or consciously deferred.

completion_lanes.name: Calendar And Reminder Live Reliability
completion_lanes.why_open: Calendar/reminder repo slices are complete, and the owner-scoped 09:00 Telegram todo-digest task is canonical and ready for live smoke; actual delivery is blocked until TELEGRAM_AGENT_REPLY_ENABLED and a server-side Telegram target are configured.
completion_lanes.done_when: One harmless recurring Telegram reminder/todo digest and, separately if approved, one CalDAV writeback smoke are created, delivered/observed, redacted and documented without multiplying one weekday reminder into multiple tasks.

completion_lanes.name: Autonomous Coding Runtime Control
completion_lanes.why_open: Autonomous coding contracts, sandbox evidence and runner state are repo-ready; read-only readiness shows sandbox execution is blocked by missing Podman or host runner availability plus a concrete live_enabled bounded job request, and Telegram supervision is blocked by missing dispatch config.
completion_lanes.done_when: A bounded coding task can be started/observed/paused from the approved control surface, checked in the sandbox, and reported over Telegram without Telegram becoming the primary development UI.

completion_lanes.name: AI GUI Tooling And Visual Operation
completion_lanes.why_open: Browser Sense, DevTools evidence and no-GPU visual observer contracts exist, but screenshot delivery is blocked by Telegram dispatch config and final tool placement remains UI/design-owned.
completion_lanes.done_when: Odysseus can request an approved GUI observation or bounded interaction job for a software project, capture redacted screenshots plus DOM/accessibility/OCR/console/network evidence, attach the result to coding, website research and Memory/RaptorGraph workflows, and send selected screenshot artifacts to Telegram without broad host-GUI access.

completion_lanes.name: MCP Workbench Activation
completion_lanes.why_open: Local MCP contracts and policy tests are ready, but Codex-side MCP services and local Odysseus MCP live smoke need explicit setup/evidence.
completion_lanes.done_when: Available Codex-side services are configured in the safe order: Playwright/browser, GitHub connector/MCP, docs MCPs, local Odysseus MCP smoke, Podman read-only probes; each has redacted read/write classification.

completion_lanes.name: Nextcloud Import Pilot And Memory Decision
completion_lanes.why_open: Copy-only Nextcloud live smoke is closed, full metadata inventory is complete, and local-only extraction/review executor exists; live readiness now shows WebDAV config and bounded subset/request are missing before any private-content extraction or Memory/RaptorGraph write pilot.
completion_lanes.done_when: A bounded local-only document subset is extracted/reviewed by local model, aggregate gate summary is produced, and Memory/RaptorGraph writes are either explicitly approved for safe abstractions or deferred.

completion_lanes.name: Observability Ops On Debian
completion_lanes.why_open: Unified runtime logging, MCP debugging, incident models and Debian observability contracts are repo-ready; host metrics, Podman metrics, Loki/log shipping, Grafana exposure, CrowdSec and live smokes require operational Go.
completion_lanes.done_when: Debian host and Podman metrics/logs are collected with redaction, retention/exposure decisions are documented, and live observability smoke proves diagnosis without enabling unsafe remediation.

completion_lanes.name: Security Ops And Incident Tabletop
completion_lanes.why_open: Security incident response models and MCP debug surfaces are prepared, and synthetic tabletop evidence is complete; any CrowdSec/remediation/lockdown action still needs its own explicit operator gate.
completion_lanes.done_when: A synthetic/redacted incident tabletop creates, diagnoses and resolves an incident through policy-gated actions; remediation remains disabled unless separately approved.

completion_lanes.name: UI-Owned Integration Handoff
completion_lanes.why_open: Backend contracts for legacy chat, internal refs, diagnostics, live affordances, PDF warnings and Version 1.0 readiness are ready; UI placement and implementation are owned by the UI agent.
completion_lanes.done_when: UI agent wires the existing backend contracts, new UI goes live, and backend ABC only verifies routes/readiness without changing legacy/v2 UI hotfiles.

completion_lanes.done_when: A live reindex/migration plan has rollback evidence and quality gates, or the track is explicitly deferred until diagnostics show a real scale problem.
